# discord_server (Data Source)

Looks up a server (guild) the bot is a member of.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_server" "main" {
  id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server ID.

### Read-Only

- `afk_channel_id` (String) AFK voice channel ID.
- `afk_timeout` (Number) AFK timeout in seconds.
- `description` (String) Server description.
- `features` (Set of String) Enabled server features.
- `icon_hash` (String) Hash of the server icon.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the server owner.
- `preferred_locale` (String) Preferred locale.
- `premium_tier` (Number) Server boost level (0-3).
- `rules_channel_id` (String) Rules channel ID.
- `system_channel_id` (String) System messages channel ID.
- `verification_level` (String) Verification level: `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `very_high`.
